Middle-aged Man"Arre, the speed! Like this—BAHYOON! Bas, gone!"
Tadayasu"Deep in the bamboo grove?"
Middle-aged Man"Haan. Between the stalks, slipping through. Quick like a weasel, something like that. But..."
Konatsu"But?"
Middle-aged Man"A person, I think? Shape toh aadmi ka tha. Human shape. Only, a person doesn't move that way."
Middle-aged Man"Could have been a monkey. But probably that was—"
Yuhi"..."
Middle-aged Man"Ah... nahin, nothing. Monkey from the mountains, bas. Plenty of those fools come down. Digging for bamboo shoots, perhaps. Ha ha."
Middle-aged Man"...Ho gaya? Uncle also has work, you know."
Yuhi"Yes... Thank you. Thank you very much."

en.html:
We watched him hurry off. A regular in the shops around here. Then we looked at each other. Nobody said anything.

The drinking street beside the bamboo grove. While asking about the night three days ago, we'd heard of somebody seeing something strange. That was how we'd found him.

What he had nearly said before swallowing the words—haan, not difficult to guess.

A human figure, running at a speed no human could. Aadmi, but not only aadmi.

A warrior.

And warrior meant Rokuhara. Outside Rokuhara, possessing a tsurugi was forbidden. Just after the war, GHQ's tsurugi hunt had confiscated almost all the others.

Hide yours? Eventually they found you. Or you rebelled and got crushed. Armor went, life went with it. Such incidents used to happen everywhere. Perhaps there was nobody left to try. These days, we hardly heard of them.

At least around Kamakura, Rokuhara's grip on warriors and their armor was complete.

Exception... racing armor. Bas, about the only one.

そそくさと歩き去っていく、この辺の店では常連の
おっちゃんを見送って。
　おれたちは黙ったまま、顔を見合わせた。

　竹林近くの飲み屋通り。
　三日前の夜について聞き込むうち、なにかおかしな
ものを見た人がいるという話を聞き、探し当てたのが
今の人だった。

　あのおっちゃんが最後に何を言おうとして中断し、
口を濁したのか。想像に難くない。
　
　――異様な迅速さで駆ける人影。

　それはつまり、人にして人ならぬもの。

　武者。

　そして武者とは六波羅に他ならない。
　六波羅に属さない人間の劔冑所持は禁じられている
のだから。終戦直後にＧＨＱが実施した劔冑狩り政策
によって、六波羅外の劒冑はほぼ全て没収されている。

　隠匿し没収を免れた人も、やがて摘発され――又は
反乱を起こして滅ぼされ、結局は命ごと劒冑を失った。
　一時期は各地で頻発したその手の事件も、もう種が
尽きたのだろう、最近はとんと聞かなくなっている。

　現在、少なくとも鎌倉周辺において、六波羅による
武者と劒冑の一元掌握は完璧だ。
　
　例外は……競技用劔冑くらいだが。

Nahin. Impossible.

For one thing, armor racers weren't allowed to operate in armor outside approved circuits.

...Almost clear, then. Unless that uncle had seen it wrong, a Rokuhara warrior had been in the grove three nights ago.

When Ritsu disappeared.

Slave trade.

The words stank. They pressed against the back of my head. Last night, one possibility among others. Bas, one possibility, and I could keep looking somewhere else.

Now that terrible nothing-we-can-do-about-it was turning my head back.

en.html:
We were probably all thinking it. The suspicion had become so real, so suddenly. Still nobody said it. Same reason that uncle had stopped talking.

Rokuhara se nahin lad sakte. We couldn't fight them.

Couldn't fight them, and now they stood in our way?

Rokuhara. Never a welcome name. But I had never felt its weight like this. Food restrictions, forced labor, emergency taxes. Haan, pressure all the time. Somehow, though, still within what we could bear.

Until now.

Now a friend was being taken from us by overwhelming force. Or had been taken already.

Kuch karna padega. We had to do something.

What?

Rokuhara was the strongest power in Yamato. Nothing anywhere could stand against it.

Justice? Where was its strength?

Nowhere.

ja.html:
一挙に現実感の高まった推測を、誰もが脳裏に思い
浮かべているだろうに、一人として口にしない。
　その理由はさっきのおっちゃんと同じだった。

　<ruby>六波羅には刃向かえない<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。
　刃向かえないのに……立ち塞がるのか。それが。

　六波羅。
　もともと快くもなんともない存在だったが、かつて
ここまでその重さを感じたことは一度もない。

　食料制限、労役、臨時税。圧迫は絶え間なかったに
しても、おれたちにとってまあ耐えられる範囲のこと
だった。
　これまでは。

　今。圧倒的な暴力で、友人が奪われようとしている
――あるいは既に、奪われた。
　
　どうにかしなくてはならない。

　だがどうにもしようがない。

　六波羅には逆らえないのだ。
　六波羅は大和の最強者で、対抗できる力はどこにも
ない。

　正義の力はどこにもない。

Konatsu was probably tired of pretending to be lighthearted. At last the heaviness came into her voice.

And I was supposed to answer? Mere paas kya tha? Nothing.

Pray for a god of justice who didn't exist to come down? Or think a little more practically: Bhagwan, if justice is not available, send disaster. Send it to Rokuhara.

Either would do.

Not much difference, from here.

en.html:
Fuck. Ah, fuck. Kya kar raha hai, Yuhi?

Why was I taking it out on him? What kind of bastard did that make me?

We needed the facts. Tadayasu was right. As usual. Nothing was settled yet. First find out what happened to Ritsu.

But I was scared.

Get proof. Proper proof, no doubt left. Know exactly what happened and still be able to do nothing. Apni aukaat, laid out in front of me. That was what I was scared of.

Give up now, and I could keep pretending. Ritsu had wandered off somewhere. Having fun. Haan, somewhere, perfectly happy.

Some part of me was actually considering that.

So weak.

Arre, so pathetically weak I could have cried.

糞……ああ糞、最低だ。

　忠保は正しい。いつも通り。

　リツがどうなったのかを確かめなくちゃならない。

　だけど怖い。

幻想にすがりつくこともできると。

en.html:
A dark sort of fellow.

Look carefully, he was young. Look more carefully, not bad-looking either. Leave all that beyond the horizon. First impression: andhera. Darkness had come in person.

One touch, and a youth in the full bloom of life might become a middle-aged uncle who had seen enough. Youthful enthusiasm, seedha retirement.

Almost demonic.

ja.html:
それは薄暗い男だった。

　良く見れば若々しいし、さらに良く見れば悪くない
顔立ちでもあるのだが、そんなことは地平線の彼方へ
置き捨てて第一印象はただ単に、暗い。

　触れるだけで、青春真っ盛りの若者がたちまち人生
に疲れた中年親父に変貌しそうなほどの<ruby>蕭々<rt>しょうしょう</rt></ruby>さ。
　ほとんど悪魔的であった。

en.html:
Tadayasu's voice had acquired a strange tune. For once, this fellow was shrinking back.

Fair enough. Even from here, that black miasma pressed against us. Paas jaayein? How to go closer?

おかしなイントネーションで忠保が言う。
　この男には珍しく、腰が引けていた。

距離で既にひしひしと感じる。

en.html:
Unanimous. Excellent. The difficult part would be somebody else's problem, and that somebody was us a little later.

Keeping our distance, we followed. The man walked on, giving off such waves of darkness that passersby leaned away.
